summary: Iteration 37 — per-staff leave-quota overrides (Team quotas tab + ClientDetail editor), calendar filters (SA office + member, OA member-only), and lead conversion funnel on SA + OA dashboards. Backend: 12/12 pytest PASS. Frontend E2E: all testids render and behave as spec'd. Regression intact.

GET /api/leave/quotas/team — OA scoped to own office staff only
PUT/GET/DELETE /api/leave/quotas/user/{uid} — OA can override own-office staff (Fathima), GET reflects, DELETE clears

POST /api/clients name='Fathima Telecaller' KM_BLR + GET /api/clients/{id}/detail → staff_login_user resolved with leave_quota + has_override (cleanup deleted)

SA /leave → leave-tab-quotas → team-quota-list with 8 members; quota-edit-<id> opens staff-quota-dialog; staff-quota-{casual,sick,earned} editable; staff-quota-save persists; quota-override-<id> badge appears; staff-quota-reset removes the badge
SA /leave → Calendar tab → cal-filter-office AND cal-filter-member both render
OA /leave → Team quotas tab shows only 1 staff card (Fathima, KM_BLR) — cross-office scoping enforced
OA /leave → Calendar tab → cal-filter-office HIDDEN, cal-filter-member visible (RBAC correct)

SA /clients/<id> for staff 'Fathima Telecaller' → client-employee-id, client-place, client-address, client-leave-quota, client-edit-quota render; clicking edit opens staff-quota-dialog; saving casual=21 updates the quota card text
client-photo only renders when photo_url is present (conditional fallback to initials avatar — matches spec)
Regression: My requests + Approvals tabs visible; Leave policy button (SA only) still present

critical_code_review_comments: routers/leave.py::_resolve_quota_target — clean RBAC: SA → staff|office_admin, OA → staff in own office. 403 enforced before any write.
routers/leave.py::_effective_quota merges per-user override on top of global policy; unpaid=None correctly preserved as unlimited.
routers/leave.py::leave_calendar accepts optional office (SA-only effective — staff/OA filters still force own scope) + optional member (any role). YYYY-MM validated with 400 on bad input.
routers/leave.py::quota_team — projection excludes _id and password_hash; sorted by name; returns {global, members[{id,name,email,role,office,quota,has_override}]}.

Backend PATCH semantics quirk (out-of-scope for this iteration): /api/clients/{id} PATCH uses ClientIn which model_dumps ALL fields — partial PATCH with only {'name': ...} will wipe office/client_type/etc. to None. The home_office is preserved with an explicit model_fields_set check but other fields are not. Recommend extending the same guard to office/client_type/email/phone/etc. or switching PATCH to a partial schema. Not blocking iteration-37 features.
Frontend ClientDetail.jsx — client-photo testid is gated on photo_url; matches the 'photo avatar OR initials' spec.
LeadFunnel.jsx wired into both Dashboard (super_admin) and OfficeDashboard with consistent testids: lead-funnel, funnel-stage-<key>, funnel-conversion-rate, funnel-lost, funnel-missed.
Cleanup: temp client and quota overrides created during testing were deleted via DELETE endpoints; no stray data left.
